action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 5d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Purifying Flames {@recharge 4}
entries: Barachiel wreathes his sword in white flame, then makes a Greatsword attack. On a hit, the target takes an additional 45 ({@damage 7d12}) fire damage plus 45 ({@damage 7d12}) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition stunned} condition until the end of their next turn.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Barachiel adds 5 to his AC against one attack. To do so, Barachiel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
